hypothesis: A source-tagged, mass-conserving agricultural N state model can couple the registered monthly source calendar to frozen fast, percolation and lower-slow water fluxes without an empirical TN lag.

pre_1961_spinup.forcing: repeat the same 1961-1970 CENTRAL source and frozen hydrology sequence independently for every candidate

source_entry.MAN: agricultural legacy pool for LEG candidates; direct mineral input for L0
source_entry.BNF: agricultural legacy pool for LEG candidates; direct mineral input for L0

month_order: mineralize the registered fraction of the legacy pool
apply crop removal proportionally to available mineral source tags
mobilize one shared mineral pool with fast plus percolation water contact
partition mobilized N by actual fast/percolation water volumes
add percolated N to the lower dissolved-N pool
release lower dissolved N only with actual local slow water
